_provenance.sourceTitle: APPENDIX VI – NDCC Ballroom Syllabus Step List, Competitions & Medal Test
_provenance.sourceAuthor: George Pytlik / National Dance Council of Canada
_provenance.column: Waltz (column 1 of 4: Waltz · Tango · Foxtrot · Quickstep)
_provenance.method: Two-pass BLIND verification, same method as the Quickstep extraction. Pass 1: independent `pdftotext -layout` column extraction (crop -x 41 -W 140 pts, isolating the Waltz numbers + names columns). Pass 2: independent transcription from a 220-DPI rasterized crop of the Waltz column (numbers + names columns isolated, x 128-552 px, enlarged 3x, read band by band). Blindness within a single context was achieved by ORDERING: Pass 2 was transcribed and written to disk in full BEFORE any pdftotext output was generated or viewed, so the model-authored pass could not be contaminated; Pass 1 is machine-generated and therefore independent regardless of order. The two passes were then reconciled by `diff`: they agreed EXACTLY on all 32 figures, so no disagreement needed resolving against the raster. Names are exactly as printed; nothing expanded, corrected, or inferred.
_provenance.status: EXTRACTED — pending Victor's confirmation. Not yet audited.
_provenance.rules: Figure-name → tier/number is dance content. This file is the verbatim NDCC side only. Matching these names to ballroomguide figure names is a separate step done by Claude Code in the parser, with fuzzy/unmatched pairs flagged for Victor (never guessed). ballroomguide coverage gaps are NOT recorded here — they belong in the Step 4 anomalies doc. This file is the citation base ONLY: it has deliberately NOT been reconciled against the 34 existing data.js Waltz keys, and data.js was not touched by this extraction.
notes: syllabusNumber is per-dance and cumulative across tiers — Waltz runs its own 1..32 sequence, NOT a global number shared with the other dances.

Beginners tier IS populated for Waltz (figures 1–6), like Tango and Quickstep and unlike Foxtrot whose Beginners cell is blank. Per-tier counts: Beginners 6 / Pre-Bronze 3 / Bronze 7 / Silver 9 / Gold 7 = 32.

WRAP CHECK (mandatory per the 2026-07-25 lesson from Foxtrot #11–15 and Tango #4–5/#16–20): for every tier band the count of printed text lines was compared against the count of figure numbers, measured from the raster's ink profile (numbers column x 130–185, names column x 188–549, per-column ink thresholds). Result: Beginners 6/6, Pre-Bronze 3/3, Bronze 7/7, Silver 9/9, Gold 7/7 — 32 numbers and 32 text lines, with every text line vertically aligned to its own number row (max |Δ| 5 px, well inside the ~28 px line pitch). NO NAME WRAPS ACROSS LINES ANYWHERE IN THE WALTZ COLUMN; every figure occupies exactly one printed line. Independently corroborated by the Gold Star cell, which states 'Steps 1 – 32'. Waltz is the only one of the four columns free of wrap artifacts. No binding was left visually unresolved.

Figure 6 prints as 'Chassé from Promenade' — the word 'Position' is NOT printed, and the wrap check confirms there is no continuation line beneath it (the Beginners cell has 6 numbers and 6 text lines). Transcribed verbatim, NOT expanded. Noted because the existing data.js key is 'Chassé from PP' and dancecentral prints 'Chassé from Promenade Position'. CONFIRM intended name.

ACCENTS: only two figure names contain a non-ASCII character, both the 'é' of 'Chassé' (#6, #16). Figures 10 and 32 print as 'Reverse Corte' and 'Hover Corte' with NO acute accent on 'Corte' — verified in both passes and at byte level. The existing data.js keys are 'Reverse Corté' and 'Hover Corté' WITH the accent. Transcribed verbatim without the accent; reconciling that difference is a later task.

AMPERSAND: the source is internally inconsistent within the Silver band — #19/#20 print the word 'and' ('Open Telemark and Cross Hesitation', 'Open Telemark and Wing') while #22/#23 print '&' ('Open Impetus & Cross Hesitation', 'Open Impetus & Wing'). #30 also prints '&'. Preserved exactly as printed; not normalized.
Figure 29 prints as 'Turning Lock to Right' (word 'Right' in full), while figure 16 prints 'Progressive Chassé to Right'. Preserved as printed.

Inter-word typographic spacing in the source is wide and uneven (e.g. 'Closed  Changes', 'Reverse  Corte'); it is not part of the name and is normalized to single spaces, the same ruling applied to the space in Quickstep's 'V 6'.

Gold Star tier lists no individual figures: the source states 'Steps 1 – 32 plus Gold Star groups / Fig. 1 – 32 plus groupes Etoile d'Or'. No Gold Star figure records are emitted (same as Foxtrot and Quickstep).

Viennese Waltz band EXCLUSION (decision, not omission): below the Gold Star row the page carries a 'VIENNESE WALTZ / VALSE VIENNOISE' section whose Bronze cell sits directly under column 1 and lists its own figures 1–3 ('Change Steps Forward, Natural & Reverse', 'Natural Turn', 'Reverse Turn'). That is Viennese Waltz content, not Waltz, and is deliberately not transcribed here. The Waltz column proper ends at raster y 1893 (0.782 of page height).

Tier labels are bilingual in the source ('Beginners - Débutants', 'Pre-Bronze – Pré-Bronze', 'Bronze', 'Silver - Argent', 'Gold - Or', 'Gold Star – Etoile d'Or'); syllabusLevel uses the English form (normalized to 'Pre-Bronze') to match the existing data.js Waltz/Tango entries and the Tango/Foxtrot/Quickstep sibling files.

Column geometry (page-width fractions, for reproducibility): Waltz numbers 0.0684–0.0995; Waltz names 0.0995–0.2947. Derived from detected vertical table rules at x = 128, 186, 551 px on the 1870×2420 raster. The same detector reproduces the Quickstep file's recorded geometry (0.7551 / 0.7818 / 0.9765 vs documented 0.7553 / 0.7815 / 0.9758), confirming the method is reproducible across columns.

APOSTROPHE: no Waltz FIGURE name contains an apostrophe. The only apostrophe in the column is the curly U+2019 in the 'Etoile d'Or' tier label, which is never emitted as a figure record and never becomes a data.js key — so the curly-vs-straight apostrophe question is cosmetic and does not affect matching (same as Quickstep).
